01 — CANTTELL: a sibling paragraph is a direct child of body, outside any landmark

This rule is deliberately scoped to direct children of <body> only (see the rule's implementation notes on why a full recursive scan would be too noisy). The PASS case (all top-level body content already inside a landmark) is covered by the inline unit tests in this rule's .test.js file. Note this explanatory text is intentionally placed inside <main> so it does not itself become a second violation in this fixture.
